non_negotiables: No abdominal exercises until cleared by OB
No heavy lifting until after six-week check
Light activity only for first two weeks

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary postpartum_recovery:
    name "Postpartum Recovery and Return to Fitness"
PHASES
  PHASE "Early Recovery" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 20m "Gentle Walking":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x15 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 20m "Mobility & Stretch":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          child_pose 2x30 rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30 rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          neck_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 20m "Strength & Balance":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          wall_ball 2x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Sunday training 15m "Restorative Stretch":
        warmup:
          wrist_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          butterfly_stretch 2x30 rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x30 rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2m
